implementationNotes.subject: Lease identities and navigation
implementationNotes.detail: Capture finish/fail/suspend/close must compare capture-control identity and session identity. Ready state never recaptures on child push/pop or ordinary retry. Only pending/no-ready capture can retry. Acquired worker source/origin must correspond to same session, and close prevents new acquisitions. Tests should observe actual Back owner closure and late completion refusal, not infer it solely from onDisappear.
